neighborhoods.name: San Jose
neighborhoods.description: Tinian's only town and its commercial, civic, and social center, where roughly 90 percent of the island's approximately 2,000 residents live, on the sheltered southwest coast facing Tinian Harbor
neighborhoods.character: Small-town, harbor front, everything-in-one-village, very quiet, close-knit

housing.predominantType: Modest single-family concrete homes and a handful of small apartment units; very thin rental market

neighborhoods.character_notes: San Jose has the island's only clinic (the Tinian Health Center, a CHCC satellite), a few grocery stores, and little else — anything beyond routine care means a short flight or boat to Saipan, and serious care means medevac off-island entirely, so retirees with ongoing medical needs should think hard before choosing Tinian. Under Article 12 of the CNMI Constitution only persons of Northern Marianas descent may own land, so non-NMD residents rent or hold leases capped at 55 years, and the rental pool is tiny — often found by word of mouth rather than listings. Super Typhoon Yutu devastated Tinian in 2018; concrete construction and a generator are practical necessities, and a car is essential even within this small island.

neighborhoods.name: Marpo Heights
neighborhoods.description: A small residential subdivision on the rise northeast of San Jose, one of the few settled areas outside the main village, with a few hundred residents
neighborhoods.character: Residential, elevated, rural, homestead lots, very quiet

housing.predominantType: Single-family homestead houses; rentals are rare and informal

neighborhoods.character_notes: Marpo Heights is a homestead neighborhood a short drive above San Jose — quiet, breezy, and entirely dependent on a car for the clinic, stores, and the airport. Available rentals may number in the single digits at any given time, so retirees should line up housing before committing to the island. Getting to Saipan for shopping or medical appointments means a roughly 10-minute commuter flight or a boat trip, and weather can disrupt both.

neighborhoods.name: Carolinas Heights
neighborhoods.description: A small elevated settlement on the Carolinas plateau in southern Tinian, home to a couple hundred residents on rural homestead lots, recorded at 223 people in the 2020 census

housing.predominantType: Scattered single-family homes on large lots; almost no formal rental listings

neighborhoods.character_notes: Carolinas Heights is the cheapest and most isolated option on an already isolated island: no shops, no services, and a drive down to San Jose for everything including the island's only clinic. It suits self-sufficient retirees who want land, quiet, and ocean-plateau scenery, and who can handle typhoon prep (Yutu in 2018 flattened much of Tinian's housing) and off-island travel for any significant healthcare. As everywhere in the CNMI, Article 12 means non-NMD residents lease rather than buy, which is why no purchase price is shown.
